text: 据中国证监会官网披露，7月10日，长江存储控股股份有限公司首次公开发行股票并上市辅导工作进展情况报告（第一期）披露。中信证券、中信建投两家券商合计派出31人组成辅导团队，本期辅导期为2026年5月19日至6月30日，通过现场尽调、组织集中授课、专项问题沟通等多种辅导方式开展辅导工作。
text_en: According to the CSRC website, on July 10, Yangtze Memory Holdings Co., Ltd. disclosed its first progress report on its IPO and listing辅导work. Citic Securities and CSC each dispatched a total of 31 personnel to form a tutoring team, with the tutoring period from May 19 to June 30, 2026, conducting work through on-site due diligence, centralized lectures, and issue-specific communications.
